notes: Ἄρχοντες is anarthrous, so the supplied address word Ye is an ordinary rule 7 helper on the noun rather than an article's realization (rule 89).
πνεύματος ἁγίου is anarthrous, so with the rides with the noun under rule 51's anarthrous clause; contrast 4:31, where an article is present and takes with the under rule 21.
